parts.partSubtitle: Establishing the fundamental language and tools of observation.

units.title: Speaking the Same Language
units.coreIdea: Establishes a universal language for precise and honest measurement.
units.anchoringPhenomenon: The Challenge of Mapping the World.

units.title: The Art of Observation
units.coreIdea: Describes motion quantitatively using position, velocity, and acceleration.
units.anchoringPhenomenon: The Launch and Trajectory of a Sounding Rocket.

units.title: The World in Three Dimensions
units.coreIdea: Analyzes complex, two-dimensional motion as the sum of simple, independent linear motions.
units.anchoringPhenomenon: The First Use of a Cannon at the Siege of Constantinople.

parts.partSubtitle: Discovering the universal laws that govern motion, energy, and interactions.

units.title: The Why of Motion
units.coreIdea: Introduces Force as the cause of changes in motion, governed by Newton's Laws.
keySkills: Applying Newton's Second Law (ΣF=ma) with free-body diagrams
units.anchoringPhenomenon: The Construction of the Great Pyramid.

units.title: The Universe's Accounting System
units.coreIdea: Tracks changes in systems using the concept of Energy and its conservation.
keySkills: Calculating Work, Power, Kinetic & Potential Energy
units.anchoringPhenomenon: The Power of the Hoover Dam.

units.title: The Conversation of Matter
units.coreIdea: Analyzes interactions and collisions through the lens of Momentum and its conservation.
keySkills: applying the Conservation of Momentum to collisions
units.anchoringPhenomenon: The 'Gravity Assist' or 'Slingshot' Maneuver of the Voyager Probes.

units.title: The Great Cosmic Waltz
units.coreIdea: Applies principles of force and motion to understand universal gravity and orbital mechanics.
keySkills: using Universal Gravitation to solve for orbital parameters
units.anchoringPhenomenon: The Design of a Geostationary Satellite.

parts.partSubtitle: Exploring the physics of waves, light, and the fundamental forces of matter.

units.title: The Traveling Ripple
units.coreIdea: Explores how energy can be transferred through space and matter via waves.
units.anchoringPhenomenon: The Sound-Dampening of a Modern Recording Studio.

units.title: The Story of Sight
units.coreIdea: Models the behavior of light as it reflects and refracts through mirrors and lenses.

units.title: The Force That Binds Us All
units.coreIdea: Investigates the fundamental electrostatic force that governs the structure of matter.
keySkills: Applying Coulomb's Law for electrostatic forces
units.anchoringPhenomenon: The Physics of a Lightning Strike.

anchoring_phenomenon.title: Mapping the World
anchoring_phenomenon.problem_description: Analyze how early cartographers created accurate maps, relying on celestial observations and rudimentary instruments, to understand the importance of shared standards and precision.
anchoring_phenomenon.provided_data: Historical measurements of the Earth's circumference (e.g., Eratosthenes) with varying levels of precision.

anchoring_phenomenon.title: Launching a Sounding Rocket
anchoring_phenomenon.problem_description: Use graphical data from a sounding rocket launch to determine its average acceleration, maximum height, and final velocity, distinguishing between different stages of motion.
anchoring_phenomenon.provided_data: A graph of velocity versus time for the rocket's vertical motion and the rocket's mass.

anchoring_phenomenon.title: The Siege at Constantinople
anchoring_phenomenon.problem_description: Model the trajectory of a cannonball using vector components to determine its range and the optimal angle for hitting a target, applying 2D motion to a historical engineering feat.
anchoring_phenomenon.provided_data: Initial velocity and launch angle of a cannonball; optional wind velocity vector.

anchoring_phenomenon.title: Constructing the Pyramids
anchoring_phenomenon.problem_description: Analyze the forces required to move massive stone blocks up an incline at a constant velocity, considering friction and mass in a practical historical context.
anchoring_phenomenon.provided_data: Mass of a stone block, angle of the ramp, and coefficients of static and kinetic friction.

units_covered.unit_name: Chapter 5: The Power of the Dam

anchoring_phenomenon.title: The Power of the Dam
anchoring_phenomenon.problem_description: Calculate the total gravitational potential energy of the water in a reservoir and determine how much of that is converted into usable electrical energy, demonstrating conservation of energy on a massive scale.
anchoring_phenomenon.provided_data: Volume of water in the reservoir, height of the dam, and turbine efficiency.

anchoring_phenomenon.title: Voyager's Gravity Assist
anchoring_phenomenon.problem_description: Use the principle of conservation of momentum in a simplified model to calculate a spacecraft's new velocity after a 'slingshot' maneuver around a planet.
anchoring_phenomenon.provided_data: Mass and velocity of the probe and planet before the interaction.

anchoring_phenomenon.title: Geostationary Satellites
anchoring_phenomenon.problem_description: Use the law of universal gravitation and equations for circular motion to calculate the exact orbital radius required for a satellite to remain in a fixed position relative to the Earth's surface.
anchoring_phenomenon.provided_data: The mass of the Earth and its period of rotation.

anchoring_phenomenon.title: Noise-Cancelling Headphones & Studios
anchoring_phenomenon.problem_description: Analyze the principles of wave superposition, interference, and resonance to explain how sound can be absorbed or cancelled in practical applications.
anchoring_phenomenon.provided_data: Waveform diagrams and schematics of sound-dampening structures.

anchoring_phenomenon.title: Corrective Lenses
anchoring_phenomenon.problem_description: Use ray diagrams and the lens equation to analyze how converging or diverging lenses adjust the focal point of the eye to correct for vision problems.
anchoring_phenomenon.provided_data: A diagram of the human eye and a description of a specific vision defect.

anchoring_phenomenon.title: A Lightning Strike
anchoring_phenomenon.problem_description: Use Coulomb's Law to analyze the immense electrostatic force between a storm cloud and the ground, and describe the flow of energy during the discharge.
anchoring_phenomenon.provided_data: The amount of charge separation and the distance between the cloud and the ground.
